entries.title: Stellar Blade
entries.definitive_edition: Stellar Blade on Windows PC (current patched release)

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows PC release with current patches, high-resolution textures, and appropriate DLSS/FSR/native settings for the capture machine.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Highest: native PC route with unlocked frame-rate and display/aspect-ratio flexibility.

primary.version: Stellar Blade on Windows PC (current patched release)
primary.why: Sami chose PC, and the official PC release post supports that route with unlocked frame rate, DLSS/FSR support, ultrawide/super-ultrawide support, and high-resolution background textures. The same post says the additional PC-release content is also available on PS5 via patch, so PC gives the best fidelity without sacrificing sourced content completeness.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release through Steam with current patches; enable the 4K texture option if hardware allows, use DLSS/FSR or native rendering as appropriate, and keep the official patched content set installed.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS5 release with console graphics modes and DualSense support, but less configurable than PC.
all_releases.reason: skip: PS5 is the original release, but the official PC post says the PC-release additional content is also available on PS5, so no exclusive content route is required; PC remains Sami?s chosen and highest-fidelity route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with unlocked frame rate, DLSS/FSR, ultrawide/super-ultrawide support, and a high-resolution texture option.
all_releases.reason: primary: Sami?s chosen platform and the strongest fidelity route while retaining the patched content set.

all_releases.fidelity: Sourced announced 2026 platform; final fidelity/content parity should be revisited after release.
all_releases.reason: skip: announced/future platform in the platform list, but not the current best-fidelity route and no exclusive content exists.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced content-completeness conflict: the official PC post says the PC-release additional content is also available on PS5 via patch.

entries.remaster_caveats: Nintendo Switch 2 is listed as a 2026 platform but should be rechecked after release for final performance/content parity; no secondary route is promoted without exclusive content.
